name: University of Klagenfurt
summary: Campus university in Klagenfurt, Carinthia, with six bachelor's taught in English, from robotics and AI to business, media and social sciences.

ib.text: Austria accepts the IB Diploma without an equivalence check (ministry); AAU adds no IB rule. English-taught degrees need English B2, which an EU/EEA school-leaving English pass proves; no German needed.

dates.label: EU/EEA: general admission period for the winter semester ends (5 September each year)
Non-EU: winter-semester applications accepted 1 April to 30 June each year

programmes.name: Digital Media, Culture, and Communication
programmes.about: How platforms such as Instagram, TikTok and YouTube work, how organisations communicate strategically online, and how to read the data trails we leave; a 120-credit major plus minors you choose.
programmes.selectionNote: No selection: with the IB Diploma and English B2 you are admitted. Enrol in the general admission period (6 July to 5 September in 2026).

programmes.name: Information and Communications Engineering
programmes.about: Computer science, electrical engineering, physics and maths applied to how technical systems capture, transmit, process and secure information: circuits, sensors, networks and signal processing, with lab and project work.
programmes.selectionNote: No selection: with the IB Diploma and English B2 you are admitted. Enrol in the general admission period (6 July to 5 September in 2026).

programmes.name: International Business and Economics
programmes.about: Accounting, controlling, marketing, HR, logistics, data analytics and economics, taught in English throughout, with an optional double degree spending part of your studies at the University of Ljubljana.
programmes.ib: Own selection before the general admission: an English motivation letter and an online exam in English. Register early in the year; 2027 dates not yet published.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026: an eight-sentence motivation letter (must be complete), then a one-hour open-book online multiple-choice exam on set readings; ranked on exam points. 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: Robotics, maths, physics, software development and artificial intelligence, with hands-on seminars flying drones and programming robots, including in the university's indoor drone flight hall.
programmes.selectionNote: No selection: with the IB Diploma and English B2 you are admitted. Enrol in the general admission period (6 July to 5 September in 2026).

programmes.name: Social Sciences
programmes.about: Sociology, geography, psychology, science and technology studies, political science and media studies combined to analyse the challenges societies face; a 120-credit major plus minors you choose.
programmes.selectionNote: No selection: with the IB Diploma and English B2 you are admitted. Enrol in the general admission period (6 July to 5 September in 2026).

programmes.name: Worlds of English
programmes.about: The English language, linguistics, literatures and the cultures of the anglophone countries, with strong encouragement to spend part of your studies in an English-speaking country.
programmes.ib: English B2. A Latin exam is due before your last bachelor's exam, unless your school Latin totalled at least 10 weekly hours.
programmes.selectionNote: No selection: with the IB Diploma and English B2 you are admitted. Enrol in the general admission period (6 July to 5 September in 2026).

notes: Only International Business and Economics has a selection; the other five admit everyone who holds the Diploma and English B2.
In International Business and Economics you can add a year in Ljubljana from the third semester and earn a Slovenian degree as well, if nominated.
